name: email
label: Email
customer_names: the email I have with you

modes.title: Cannot sign in to email
modes.symptom: mailboxes refusing correct passwords at sign-in
customer_says: I can't get into my email. It says my password is wrong, and I haven't changed it.
My email won't let me log in on the website or on my phone. It was fine the last time I used it.
The email sign-in keeps rejecting me. I've tried resetting the password and that fails too.
I'm locked out of my email account. Every attempt says the details are not recognised.

causes.cause: a directory server that fell out of sync with the mail platform
fixes: resynchronising the directory server with the mail platform

causes.cause: a lockout rule triggered across a whole range of accounts
fixes: lifting the lockout rule from the affected accounts

causes.cause: an identity service outage in the regional data hall
fixes: failing the identity service over to another data hall

workarounds: read mail on a phone or tablet that is already signed in
use the read-only webmail address listed on the service status page
aftercare: sign in again with the usual password
ignore any password reset emails requested during the fault

modes.title: Incoming mail delayed
modes.symptom: incoming messages held in a delivery queue
customer_says: I'm not receiving any emails. People say they've sent me things and my inbox is empty.
Emails are taking ages to reach me. A booking confirmation never turned up.
Nothing new has come into my inbox, and I know for certain that messages have been sent.
My email has gone quiet. I sent myself a test from another account and it hasn't arrived.

causes.cause: a virus scanning engine that stalled on a malformed attachment
fixes: restarting the virus scanning engine with the bad attachment quarantined

causes.cause: a mail routing record pointing at a retired server
a storage quota fault that froze inbound delivery

workarounds: ask senders to copy urgent messages to a second email address
check the spam folder, where a few delayed messages are landing
aftercare: expect held messages to arrive in order of their original sending time
ask senders to resend anything that has not arrived by the end of the day

modes.title: Cannot send mail
modes.symptom: outgoing messages bouncing back with a relay error
customer_says: I can't send emails. They sit in the outbox and then come back with a failure notice.
Every email I send bounces. I can receive fine, but nothing will go out.
My outgoing mail isn't working. I get a message about the relay being denied.
Emails I send come straight back as undeliverable, even to my own family.

causes.cause: an outbound mail relay placed on a third-party blocklist
fixes: moving outbound mail to a clean relay address

causes.cause: a sending limit set to zero by a faulty anti-abuse update
an expired security certificate on the sending servers
fixes: installing a new security certificate on the sending servers

workarounds: send from the webmail page rather than a mail program
save urgent messages as drafts and send them once relaying is restored
aftercare: resend any message that bounced during the fault
empty the outbox of stuck messages before sending again

modes.title: Folders and old mail missing
modes.symptom: folders and older messages missing from mailboxes
customer_says: All my email folders have gone. Years of saved messages aren't showing.
My inbox only shows this week's emails. Everything older has disappeared.
The folders I keep my receipts in have vanished from my email account.
Half my email is missing. I can see new messages, but none of my old ones.

causes.cause: a mailbox migration that paused halfway
a search index that failed to load after a restart
an archive storage tier that went offline
fixes: bringing the archive storage tier back online

workarounds: open older messages from a mail program that keeps its own copy
use the search by date option, which still reaches archived mail
aftercare: refresh the folder list in webmail
check the restored folders and report anything still missing

wrong_customer_side: a mailbox that has gone over its storage limit
a forwarding rule set up by mistake
an outdated mail program on the computer
a password saved wrongly in the phone
wrong_provider_side: a planned move to a new email system
a wave of spam slowing every mailbox
a security lock placed after a suspected breach
a fault at the other person's email provider
